deltas.title_id: Peraturan Menteri Perdagangan Nomor 19 Tahun 2026 tentang Perdagangan Melalui Sistem Elektronik (PMSE)
deltas.title_en: Ministry of Trade Regulation No. 19/2026 on Electronic Commerce — Mandatory NIB for E-Commerce Sellers
deltas.impact_note: PT PMA and Indonesian entities selling via marketplace/e-commerce must hold NIB in the trading sector. Platforms (PPMSE) must reject registrations without NIB after 6-month grace (new sellers) or 18-month (existing sellers). Relevant for Bali Zero clients with e-commerce/marketplace KBLI.
deltas.summary: Permendag 19/2026 mandates that e-commerce sellers (domestic and foreign) must hold a valid NIB in the trading sector to register on Indonesian e-commerce platforms (PPMSE). Per Pasal 4 ayat (5): minimum requirements are (i) NIB in the trading sector and (ii) compliance with applicable technical standards. PPMSE must reject non-compliant registrations (Pasal 4 ayat 4) and restrict market access after 6 months of non-compliance. Platforms must facilitate NIB procurement per Pasal 17 ayat (1). Transition periods: 18 months for existing sellers, 6 months for new sellers.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: PPMSE yang menyediakan sarana PMSE bagi pedagang dalam negeri wajib menolak permintaan pendaftaran Pedagang dalam negeri yang belum memiliki perizinan berusaha sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan. [Pasal 4 ayat (4) Permendag 19/2026]
